text:
A beach wedding calls for something light, elegant, and comfortable—perfect for the setting! For women, flowy maxi dresses, chiffon gowns, or a short sundress in a soft color palette (think pastels, florals, or ocean-inspired tones) work beautifully. Lightweight fabrics like cotton, linen, or chiffon will keep you cool. For men, linen shirts, tailored shorts or light trousers paired with loafers or sandals are a perfect balance of casual and polished.
